notes.title: Thanks to you, the game continues: VIP Pass offered as a thank you!
notes.content:
Dear players,

It is with great pleasure that I announce we have reached the necessary amount to fund the servers for another year! Thanks to your support
We can continue to keep this game alive and offer a better experience to the entire community.

As a token of our appreciation, I am happy to offer you all a VIP Pass, which will be available in the coming months. This pass will give you access to free skins, a custom icon, and many other perks, including a special rank on our Discord server, and much more.

I sincerely thank you for your commitment.

You can join our Discord server via the link below to chat directly with me and discover the upcoming new features.
Discord

Lamondille
CEO of Cyberstorm
